description: Review module for attestation_engine.py to verify it cites dynamic evidence in attestations. Reads attestation_engine.py source and queries mcp_attestations table via ws_query to check: (1) attestation text includes dynamic signal scores from mcp_signal_scores not just static templates; (2) attestation references injection_resilience dimension if available; (3) evidence_blob is referenced in attestation output. Produces a conformance report: dynamic_evidence_cited (bool per row), missing_injection_resilience (count), static_template_only (count). High priority pass per Phase 8 status note. attestation_engine.py is protected; propose companion module only if rewrite needed.
